subject: Dedicated region quarantine & erasure stepdown — Springwell Q&A
messages:
From: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@springwell.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: security@springwell.io, procurement@springwell.io
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Dedicated region quarantine and purge process — quick Qs

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. A couple of follow-ups from our security and ops team as we finalize the procurement checklist:

1) Region pinning: we need a written confirmation that data for the dedicated cluster assigned to Springwell (SPR-7890) will not leave the US-region physical hosts and that snapshots will not replicate to other regions unless explicitly enabled.

2) Quarantine mode / snapshot hold: if Springwell requests an immediate quarantine (forensics or compliance hold), what is the operational playbook and expected time-to-complete for placing the tenant into a non-replicating, read-only state?

3) Erasure: When we request a full tenant wipe (end-of-contract), what artifacts can Redwood provide as evidence? Are there standard templates you use for customer acceptance?

If you can point to the specific runbook items or share an example evidence pack, that would help our legal and InfoSec sign-off.

Best,
Maria Ortega
Head of Security Operations
Springwell Health
[Attachment: springwell-security-checklist.xlsx]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@springwell.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@springwell.io
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated region quarantine and purge process — quick Qs

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear list. Answers below are operationally prescriptive; happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you want to walk through sequences.

1) Region pinning: We will pin SPR-7890 to the us-central region by default. That means:
   - No cross-region replication for active storage or KV caches unless you opt into cross-region DR.
   - Backups/snapshots remain in-region (logical copies stored on regional object store).
   - We record the region pin in the deployment contract and surface it in the Console under Deployment > Region binding.

2) Quarantine / isolation: Our quarantine playbook (attached as 'ops_quarantine_checklist.xlsx') does the following steps when you open a quarantine request:
   - Step 1: Place tenant into read-only mode (no write tokens accepted) — target TD: 5 minutes.
   - Step 2: Disable outbound replication jobs and snapshot export tasks — target TD: 15 minutes.
   - Step 3: Snapshot a point-in-time image (in-region only) and mark as evidence; do not replicate.
   - Step 4: Lock KV caches and preserve runtime traces for up to 30 days (per contract) unless you request longer retention.

3) Erasure / tenant wipe evidence: We provide a wipe package that includes:
   - A chain-of-ops log (operator IDs + timestamps) for deletion commands executed.
   - Snapshot deletion confirmation and object-store lifecycle events.
   - A sanitized export of tenant metadata (no content) showing zero logical objects remaining.
   - A customer-facing 'wipe confirmation' doc you can sign off on (template attached).

Attachments: redwood-region-pin-playbook.pdf, ops_quarantine_checklist.xlsx, wipe-confirmation-template.docx

We can also provide an encrypted bundle with signed operator attestations on request (we've done this for a few healthcare customers).

Let me know if we should add specific SLAs for quarantine time-to-complete or provide a red team-friendly summary for Security.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-region-pin-playbook.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated region quarantine and purge process — internal ops notes

Forwarding Maria's thread with my ops notes inline — quick, pragmatic clarifications before we send the final evidence pack to Springwell:

> From Stephanie: "Step 2: Disable outbound replication jobs and snapshot export tasks — target TD: 15 minutes."

Ben (inline): Make sure the runbook references the exact job IDs for SPR-7890 (jobs: spr7890-repl, spr7890-export). Ops will run the orchestration disable via the orchestration API which logs the action. We should include the orchestration run id in the evidence pack.

> From Stephanie: "We provide a wipe package that includes a chain-of-ops log ..."

Ben (inline): We will need InfoSec legal to approve the sanitized metadata export. Karthik, can you prepare the metadata export command and the operator attestation template? Also confirm retention window for quarantine traces (default 30 days) — Springwell may ask for 90.

Thanks,
Ben

[Attachment: ops_run_template.txt]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@springwell.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@springwell.io
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Dedicated region quarantine and purge process — Springwell Q&A (commitments & next steps)

Hi Maria — following internal ops alignment, here's a concise commitments list and next steps.

Commitments:
- Region binding: SPR-7890 will be pinned to our us-central region; no replication out-of-region unless you instruct. (Recorded in contract section 3.2).
- Quarantine timeline: we commit to an operational target of placing the tenant into read-only + replication disabled within 30 minutes of an authenticated quarantine request. We will surface orchestration run ID and snapshot evidence in the evidence bundle.
- Wipe evidence: on full termination we will deliver the wipe confirmation package (chain-of-ops, object-store deletion logs, sanitized metadata export) and provide the wipe-confirmation-template for your sign-off.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm if you require quarantine trace retention of 90 days (default is 30).
2) If ok, we'll schedule a 20-minute runbook review with your security ops and our Site Reliability team to review the attached playbook and the example evidence bundle link: https://drive.redwood.com/springwell/evidence-pack-2028

If you confirm, I'll loop in Karthik for the sanitized metadata export and Ben for the orchestration IDs.

Best regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ops_quarantine_checklist.xlsx, wipe-confirmation-template.docx]
